nodes.name: chatDisplayModeContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Small React context that tracks the current chat history display mode (e.g. normal vs. compact) and exposes a provider plus consumer hook.

nodes.name: useChatHistoryDisplayMode
nodes.summary: Hook that reads the current chat history display mode from context for use by chat history components.

nodes.name: classifiers.ts
nodes.summary: Collection of boolean predicate functions that classify normalized session events by kind (file read/edit/delete, terminal/shell activity, browser activity, todo management, agent errors) for the chat item pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: isAgentErrorEvent is documented in-source as the single source of truth for whether an event should render as an error card, making it a key dependency for downstream renderers.

nodes.name: getActionSummaryCategory
nodes.summary: Maps a session event to its action-summary grouping category used to consolidate related activity in the chat history.

nodes.name: isReadFileEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents a file-read tool action.

nodes.name: isEditFileEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents a file-edit tool action.

nodes.name: isDeleteFileEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents a file-delete tool action.

nodes.name: isFileModificationEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents any kind of file modification (edit or delete).

nodes.name: getToolSimulatorApp
nodes.summary: Maps a tool-use event to the simulator app (e.g. browser, terminal, diff) it should be associated with.

nodes.name: isEventInSimulatorApp
nodes.summary: Predicate that checks whether a given event belongs to a specific simulator app context.

nodes.name: isBrowserEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents browser-automation tool activity.

nodes.name: isShellAwaitEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents a shell command awaiting completion.

nodes.name: isTerminalActivityEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents general terminal activity.

nodes.name: isTerminalCommandEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents an executed terminal command.

nodes.name: isManageTodoEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event represents a todo-list management tool action.

nodes.name: isAgentErrorEvent
nodes.summary: Single source of truth predicate for whether a session event should be rendered as an agent error card.

nodes.name: dedup.ts
nodes.summary: Builds lookup maps and sets used to deduplicate tool-call and assistant-message session events that can otherwise appear twice due to streaming race conditions.

nodes.name: buildDedupMaps
nodes.summary: Builds lookup maps keyed by tool-call id used to identify and merge duplicate tool-call related events during pipeline processing.

nodes.name: buildUserDedupSet
nodes.summary: Builds a set of identifiers for user-message events that should be treated as duplicates and suppressed during rendering.

nodes.name: isAssistantMessageEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that determines whether an event represents a persisted assistant message, used both for dedup and for minimap preview extraction.

nodes.name: buildTextSegment
nodes.summary: Builds a normalized text segment descriptor from an assistant message event for use in dedup-set comparisons.

nodes.name: buildAssistantDedupSet
nodes.summary: Builds the set of assistant-message identifiers/text-segments considered duplicates so the pipeline can suppress redundant streamed or persisted copies.

nodes.name: filters.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the main content-visibility filter for the chat item pipeline, deciding whether a given session event will render any visible content in the chat history.

nodes.name: hasAgentMessageBody
nodes.summary: Checks whether an assistant event carries a non-empty message body worth rendering.

nodes.name: hasThinkingBody
nodes.summary: Checks whether a thinking/reasoning event carries a non-empty body worth rendering.

nodes.name: hasThinkingEventType
nodes.summary: Predicate that checks whether an event's type corresponds to a thinking/reasoning event.

nodes.name: hasShellOutput
nodes.summary: Checks whether a terminal/shell event carries output content worth rendering.

nodes.name: willEventRenderContent
nodes.summary: Main content-visibility filter that decides, across all event kinds, whether a session event will render any visible content in the chat history.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the chat item pipeline's public API: processChatItems, its option/result types, willEventRenderContent, and calculateDuration.

nodes.name: pipeline.ts
nodes.summary: Main chat item pipeline that transforms a raw session event list into optimized, display-ready chat items by grouping related activity into buffers (read-file, action-summary, browser, terminal, edit, partial) and applying classification/filtering/dedup logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses per-category buffer accumulators (readFileBuffer, actionSummaryBuffer, browserBuffer, terminalBuffer, editBuffer, partialBuffer) as a streaming reduce pattern to consolidate consecutive related activity into single display groups.

nodes.name: getErrorText
nodes.summary: Extracts a human-readable error message from a failed tool-call or agent-error event.

nodes.name: getStableActivityItemId
nodes.summary: Computes a stable identifier for an activity chat item so it can be tracked across pipeline re-runs without changing React keys.

nodes.name: isDiffProjectionEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies whether an event is a diff-projection event that should be handled specially by the pipeline.

nodes.name: processChatItems
nodes.summary: Main pipeline entry point that walks the raw session event list, classifies and filters each event, deduplicates streaming duplicates, and groups related activity into buffers to produce the final list of optimized chat items.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions for the chat item pipeline: OptimizedChatItem shape, pipeline options, and the default pipeline options constant.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Small helper functions used by the chat item pipeline buffers to decide whether two activity observations can be consolidated, merge their contents, and compute elapsed duration.

nodes.name: canConsolidate
nodes.summary: Determines whether two consecutive activity observations belong to the same buffer group and can be consolidated into one display entry.

nodes.name: mergeObservations
nodes.summary: Merges two consolidatable activity observations into a single combined observation.

nodes.name: calculateDuration
nodes.summary: Computes the elapsed duration of a grouped activity buffer from its first and last event timestamps.

nodes.name: ChatHistoryEmptyState.tsx
nodes.summary: Placeholder component rendering loading, error, or empty states for the chat history panel before any session events are available.

nodes.name: ChatHistoryList.tsx
nodes.summary: Large pure list-rendering component for the chat history, including scroll-bottom detection, extensive memo comparison helpers for props/groups, row group metadata construction, and visible/pinned group index resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains many hand-written shallow-equality comparison helpers (sameNumberArray, sameEventList, sameChatHistoryListProps, etc.) to keep React.memo re-render checks cheap for a performance-critical, high-frequency-updating list.

nodes.name: isScrolledToContentBottom
nodes.summary: Determines whether the chat history scroll container is currently scrolled to the bottom, used to decide on auto-scroll behavior for new events.

nodes.name: sameEventSummary
nodes.summary: Shallow-compares two event summary objects to decide whether a chat history row needs to re-render.

nodes.name: sameEventList
nodes.summary: Shallow-compares two lists of event summaries for memoization purposes.

nodes.name: buildRowGroupMeta
nodes.summary: Builds per-row metadata describing which conversation group each row belongs to, used for grouping headers and pinning logic.

nodes.name: sameFlatItems
nodes.summary: Shallow-compares two flattened chat item lists to determine whether the virtualized list needs to recompute layout.

nodes.name: sameChatHistoryListProps
nodes.summary: Comprehensive custom React.memo comparator for ChatHistoryList's props, combining the individual field-level comparison helpers to avoid unnecessary re-renders of the entire list.

nodes.name: resolveVisibleGroupIndices
nodes.summary: Resolves which conversation group indices are currently visible in the virtualized viewport.

nodes.name: resolveActiveGroupPinState
nodes.summary: Determines which conversation group should currently be pinned at the top of the chat history viewport.

nodes.name: ChatHistoryView.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator component for the chat history panel, wiring together empty-state handling, pinned header, search bar, minimap, planning indicator, revert dialog, and numerous hooks for state, navigation, viewport, and session reload.

nodes.name: ChatHistoryView
nodes.summary: Main chat history view component that composes the empty state, search, minimap, pinned header, planning indicator bridge, and revert-confirm dialog around the underlying chat history list.
